# Subscription commands keep the selected folder and window owner explicit

The three-pane context route forwards its actual folder to the registered cmd_subscribe callback; normal invocation can default to gFolder, and Account Central passes its selected folder. The module enables the generic dialog when any IMAP/NNTP account exists and routes selected feed folders to their own UI. Its original top-based dialog/confirmation owner differs from the later accepted topChromeWindow owner. Added tests check two server-picker values and RSS dialog opening, while the context-unsubscribe test waits for confirmation and tree removal but adds one message-free assertion. These are scoped source/test contracts, not all-window, RSS-only enablement, native-dialog or runtime equivalence proof.

Scope: Subscription command routing.
